How did Sonia Gandhi first meet Indira Gandhi? What happened when her father opposed her relationship with Rajiv Gandhi? And where did she stay when she first arrived in India inJanuary 1968?
In an interview with ThePrint, journalist and author Rasheed Kidwai recounts some lesser-known stories from Sonia Gandhi's life — from her first meeting with the Gandhi family at a Greek restaurant in England to her love story with Rajiv Gandhi, her father's objections to the relationship and her eventual arrival in India.
